fee_notes: Royalty is 7% of Gross Revenue for non-reconstruction services; 2% for reconstruction services. Brand Fee is 1%-2%, currently 1%. Local Marketing is greater of 2% or $1,000/month (rolling 3-month average). Tech fee range $173-$253/month (midpoint used). Additional fees: National Account Fee 5% of attributable revenue; Management Fee for Catastrophic Events 15% of attributable revenue.
raw_excerpt:
Royalty 7% of monthly Gross Revenue from all services except reconstruction services; 2% of monthly Gross Revenue from reconstruction services
Brand Fee 1% to 2% of monthly Gross Revenue; currently 1%
Technology Fee $173 to $253 a month
